method.title: How Evidomo works
method.lede: You give Evidomo photos and a voice walkthrough of a home. It writes the listing. Every sentence shows where it came from, and you check it before anything is shared.

sections.example: What happened to the example listing

types.form: Your form: a fact you typed in.
types.voice: Your voice: words from your walkthrough, with the time you said them.
types.photo: A photo: the part of the picture that shows it.

photos.title: 10 to 30 photos
photos.text: Take them with your phone, one room at a time. Photos only.

voice.title: A voice walkthrough
voice.text: Walk through the home and say what you see. Aim for 2 to 10 minutes. Record it in your browser, or upload an audio file.

form.title: A short form
form.text: Facts you know, such as the size of the home and the year it was built.

inputs.noVideo: Evidomo does not use video. Use photos and a voice recording only.
inputs.outputText: The listing text, answers to questions buyers often ask, a short post for social media, and your photos. Download it all as one pack.

specimen.prompt: Tap a highlighted part to see what it is based on.
specimen.conflict: The form said {form}, but the voice said {voice}. Evidomo stopped and asked the agent, who kept {voice}.
specimen.replayNote: This is a replay of a saved example. The home is made up, and the voice is computer-made. The replay plays silence instead of it.

ledger.intro: Evidomo does every step by itself. At two points it stops and waits for you to decide.
ledger.scripted: In the example, these choices were made ahead of time.

gateTitles.gate2: Stop 2 of 2: check the text and the staged photo

rows.intake: The voice walkthrough, in Dutch, is turned into text with times.
rows.fact_extraction: Facts are picked from the form and the voice. Each keeps its source.
rows.vision_inventory: {photos} photos are checked for faces and number plates. None needed blurring.
rows.reconciliation: {conflicts} facts disagree. One example: the voice said laminate, but the bedroom photo shows carpet.
rows.gate1: The agent picks {voice} over the form’s {form}, and €175 over €165. The bedroom floor is left out.
rows.creative: {portal} sentences for the listing text and {social} for social media. Each names its facts.
rows.qa_cards: {questions} questions buyers often ask, answered in {answers} sentences from the same facts.
rows.staging: The AI mistook an empty room for a bedroom and added a bed. The photo says “Virtually staged”.
rows.integrity: Windows, doors, and other fixed parts are counted before and after. Nothing changed.
rows.verification: {audited} sentences are checked against their facts. {flagged} had a problem.
rows.gate2: Nothing was flagged. The agent approves the staged photo and the text.
rows.export: {files} files are built, and every final check passes.

ledger.bedroomCaption: The voice said laminate. This bedroom photo shows carpet. An AI-made photo, not a real home.
ledger.stagingCaption: Left: an AI-made photo of an invented empty room. Right: the staged result, labelled “Virtually staged”.

numbers.intro: We hid known mistakes in made-up test homes and counted how many Evidomo caught. Tested on {date}, with {sets} made-up sets.
numbers.caption: Test results

rows.injectedFlagged: Bad sentences we slipped in, flagged
rows.injectedExported: Bad sentences that reached a final pack

limits.blatant: The mistakes we hid were easy to spot. This shows the checks work, not how often real listings contain mistakes.
limits.oneApartment: All six sets are versions of one made-up apartment. It shows the idea works, not how it does on real homes.
limits.freeform: Small details, like a floor material, are found on a best-effort basis.
limits.audio: Evidomo checks the written text, not the sound. If a word was misheard, it can slip through; you catch it at the final check.

items.valuation: Value a home or give investment advice.
items.legal: Give legal advice. Its checklist is not a legal check.
items.buyers: Screen, score, or rank buyers or tenants.
items.publishing: Publish to a listing site for you.
items.edits: Change a photo to hide a flaw or alter the building.
items.metadata: Keep the location data in your photos. It is removed when you upload.
items.blur: Share a face or a number plate. Both are blurred.
items.deletion: Keep a deleted project. Photos, voice, facts, and the listing are removed.
items.training: Let AI models train on your content.
